blueprint_rationale: Eight items gives two secure evidence opportunities per Unit 1 Mastery Goal while preserving a usable one-period summative length. Each item may integrate a paired supporting I Can when the Exit evidence map already treats them as one coherent evidence job.
form_build_sequence: V5-V6 additional secure forms under the same blueprint and comparable rigor

blueprint.evidence_job: Plot/read ordered pairs on a coordinate plane while respecting axis meaning.
Read a scaled coordinate graph and interpret an intercept shown.
Determine the same rate from a graph and a table and reconcile the two representations.
Determine rate from an equation and interpret the rate in a short context.
Substitute a value and apply order of operations accurately.
Evaluate with positive/negative values and justify whether the result is reasonable.
Use an input-output rule to find an output and record the ordered pair.
Find a missing input/output and extend a table using the same rule.
